producer_report.summary: The design doc already had no commit hash and no §8.1 reference, so I changed only the BRIEF.md pin text. Line numbers now refer to the BRIEF.md in the same tree. The doc says how to confirm them: line 306 is the bullet beginning "M1. Work handling", line 395 is the third milestone-list item, and lines 271–277 run from the "Part 2" heading to the bullet "Everything reusable lives in Athena's studying capability". If BRIEF.md changes, the reader finds the passage by those quoted words. I added a CHANGELOG entry under Changed. I did not run clippy or test, because no Rust changed.
